# flutter_app_kit

Bootstrap, flavors, secure session storage, Material Notices.

- Public barrel: lib/flutter_app_kit.dart
- bootstrap(AppConfig) is phased, idempotent, testable
- Env: flutter_dotenv wrapper (not envied)
- Flavor: AppFlavor via --dart-define=FLAVOR=
- SecureSessionStore for tokens; never passwords in SharedPreferences
- deleteUserData() wipes secure storage + prefs allowlist + optional DB hook; no navigation
- MaterialNotices implements page_kit Notices; showFailure skips null and CancelledFailure
- Vendor SDKs are optional callbacks (initFirebase / initSupabase), not package deps
- FVM Flutter 3.35.7
